reviews.text:
Please add it. Hey there!

I really like your Go Club app it has a nice design and great potential. But there’s one thing that makes it hard for me to use it daily. Right now, the water reminders are set at fixed times (like 11:00, 12:00, 1:00, etc.), no matter when I actually drink.

For example, if I drink water at 11:23, I’d love the next reminder to come at 12:23 one hour later instead of sticking to the preset times.

Another app called Waterllama does this really well. It automatically adjusts the next reminder based on when you last logged your drink, so it feels smarter and more natural.

If Go Club had a similar feature, I’d definitely switch back and use it all the time!

Thanks a lot for reading this and for the awesome work you’re doing
